code_block_sim.note: Data-block cost of a fixture code read, modelled from each store's own cf07 by packing records the way RocksDB does (flush once uncompressed size passes block_size). Deflate stands in for LZ4: comparative, not RocksDB's own figure.
code_block_sim.probe: BlockSim.java, read-only open, 200 blocks sampled per store

account_mix.note: Composition of the flat account keyspace, sampled from each store's own cf06. A Bonsai flat account is RLP(nonce, balance, storageRoot, codeHash); an EOA carries EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT and EMPTY_CODE_HASH, two shared constants. Deflate stands in for LZ4 and exaggerates the gap, so RocksDB's own block figures are authoritative for magnitude; this probe is for composition.
account_mix.probe: AcctMix.java, read-only open, 200 blocks sampled per store
